query:
UPDATE law_firms SET 
  speciality = 'Residential conveyancing, first-time buyers & new build specialists',
  yearsEstablished = 2008,
  accreditations = '["Law Society CQS","SRA Regulated","Which? Trusted Trader"]'
WHERE name = 'Prestige Law LLP';

UPDATE law_firms SET 
  speciality = 'Property law specialists with dedicated remortgage & leasehold teams',
  yearsEstablished = 1995,
  accreditations = '["Law Society CQS","Lexcel Accredited","SRA Regulated"]'
WHERE name = 'Crown Conveyancing';

UPDATE law_firms SET 
  speciality = 'Specialist in complex transactions, shared ownership & Help to Buy',
  yearsEstablished = 2001,
  accreditations = '["Law Society CQS","SRA Regulated","LSAG Member"]'
WHERE name = 'Premier Property Lawyers';

UPDATE law_firms SET 
  speciality = 'Buy-to-let, portfolio landlords & commercial property specialists',
  yearsEstablished = 2012,
  accreditations = '["CLC Regulated","LSAG Member","Which? Trusted Trader"]'
WHERE name = 'Apex Legal Services';

UPDATE law_firms SET 
  speciality = 'High-value residential, luxury property & international buyers',
  yearsEstablished = 1987,
  accreditations = '["Law Society CQS","Lexcel Accredited","SRA Regulated","LSAG Member"]'
WHERE name = 'Sterling Solicitors';
